description: Manage Snowflake pipes under /api/v2/databases/{database}/schemas/{schema}/pipes and drive Snowpipe ingestion under /v1/data/pipes/{database}.{schema}.{name}. Operations: list (like), create (body Pipe with name and copy_statement, for example auto_ingest, integration, error_integration, comment; createMode), get, delete (ifExists), refresh (ifExists, prefix, modified_after ISO-8601), set_tags, unset_tags (tags; ifExists), get_tags (withLineage), insert_files (body files: 1-5000 objects with path up to 1024 UTF-8 bytes and optional size; showSkippedFiles; requestId generated when omitted), insert_report (beginMark; requestId), load_history_scan (required startTimeInclusive, optional endTimeExclusive, ISO-8601; requestId) and fetch_result (result_handler, page). Vendor RBAC alone decides: insert_files needs OPERATE, the reports MONITOR. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Create, refresh, tag and drop Snowflake pipes, and run Snowpipe file ingestion: submit staged files to a pipe's load queue, then read the insert report and the load history to learn which files were actually loaded, with row counts and errors. Use for continuous or event-driven data loading; vendor role grants decide every call.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: family, operation, method, status (HTTP), headers, body (Pipe objects with copy_statement and invalid_reason, the vendor's status message, an insertFiles response with requestId, responseCode, unmatchedPatternFiles and skippedFiles, or an insertReport or loadHistoryScan report with files and their status), body_encoding, correlation_id, request_id for Snowpipe calls, error_code for 4xx/5xx, and pagination: next_begin_mark from insertReport, next_start_time_inclusive when a loadHistoryScan reports completeResult false, Link relations, location and result_handler for 202 responses.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This operation may have changed vendor state. Queued means the job was accepted, not that Snowflake completed the operation. Report the HTTP status, error_code and body faithfully. Report deletes, renames and swaps from the vendor status, never from job completion alone. An insert_files SUCCESS means Snowpipe queued the files, not that they were loaded: use insert_report (continue with pagination.next_begin_mark) or load_history_scan to report loads.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Manage Snowflake pipes and Snowpipe ingestion with the registered role's grants.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: snowflake.invalid_params is raised before any vendor call when the operation, identifiers, query parameter names or types (boolean ifExists and showSkippedFiles; ISO-8601 modified_after, startTimeInclusive and endTimeExclusive), a missing startTimeInclusive for load_history_scan, createMode, required body members (name and copy_statement for create) or an insert_files body whose files are empty, over 5000, lack a path, have a path over 1024 UTF-8 bytes or a negative size do not match the documented vendor shape. Vendor HTTP errors are completion data with status, body and error_code: auth_failed (401), permission_denied (403), object_not_found (404), timeout (408), conflict (409), rate_limited (429), api_error otherwise. snowflake.api_error without a status is a transport or configuration failure.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the vendor status and body before retrying. A 403 means the registered role lacks the grant: grant it in Snowflake, the plugin adds no gate of its own. Double-quote identifiers that contain other characters. For a 202, call the same verb with operation fetch_result and the pagination.result_handler. Never silently retry a mutation after a transport error: read the object first.
